title: feat(spec)!: retire AdminScope.manageBindings and authorEnvironmentSets — delegation rights no door honoured (#23488)
body:
Fixes #23488
Clause-②: yes

Executes ruling of record 6181988435 on #23488 (letter A, the maintainer's 「同意」): `AdminScope.manageBindings` and `AdminScope.authorEnvironmentSets` retire inside the 18 major by the `spec-property-retirement` route, the delegated-admin gate's strict-containment comparison stops reading them, and the text that described the removed gates is corrected. The changeset declares `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, BREAKING, ADR-0087 disposition `registered`.

The ADR half (ADR-0090 D12 status line, ADR-0086 line 446) is a separate Tier H docs PR on branch `claude/issue-23488-adr-delegation-rights-retired`, as ruling item 5 requires. The objectui half (Studio's two switches, help strings, i18n keys, pin test) is objectstack-ai/objectui#12406, filed by the seat (ruling item 4); this PR does not touch objectui.

## What changes

**1. The retirement kit (`@objectstack/spec`).**
- Two `retiredKey()` tombstones on `AdminScopeSchema` (`security/permission.zod.ts`). Each prescription says what the ruling binds: delete the key; a delegate's scope is placement, assignment and the allowlist. Both close with the house `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence.
- `DelegableAdminScope` (`contracts/security-service.ts`) drops both fields.
- D2 conversion `permission-admin-scope-binding-authoring-removed` in `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` (order 65, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`). It strips both keys from every `permissions[].adminScope`, whatever they hold, one notice per key, and the notice path names the set. Both keys carried `.default(false)`, so a 17.x parse materialized them in every declared scope. The rehydration seams replay this entry over stored rows and built artifacts (the `email_template.isSystem` precedent; `acceptRetiredDefaultResidue` is not adopted).
- `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]`: `security/AdminScope:manageBindings`, `security/AdminScope:authorEnvironmentSets`.
- D3 semantic entry `permission-admin-scope-binding-authoring-retired`, which states the containment change, plus its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 97).
- The form's help text, the generated reference page, `authorable-surface/security.json` (two rows become RETIRED), `authorable-defaults/security.json` (two default rows go), the liveness note (`liveness/permission.json`, re-verified, still `live`), and the removal-version pin's JOIN row.

**2. The containment change (`@objectstack/plugin-security`, ruling item 2).**
- `definitionContainsStrictly` compares `includeSubtree`, `manageAssignments` and the allowlist only. `resolveHeldScopes` and `describeDelegableScope` drop both flags.
- Case (ii) of reading 6172654646 becomes a refusal: a delegate whose own scope carries an inert `true` can no longer hand out a scope otherwise equal to its own. It answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- New pins in `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, under the describe `[#23488] the retired binding/authoring flags count on no containment axis`:
  - case (ii) refused, asserting `code` + `status` + the message's first clause;
  - a CONTROL: the same delegate grants a scope narrower on a real axis;
  - case (i) reversed: the granted side's retired `true` no longer out-reaches the delegate.
- Mechanism assumption 1 holds: the gate fixture set both flags `true` on both sides (`EAST_SCOPE`), so these pins are new, not flipped assertions. The six other plugin-security fixtures drop the keys.

**3. The legacy-row ceremony (`@objectstack/core`, ruling item 3) — measured, and the mapper drops the keys.**
- The measurement used a scratch test, not committed, in `packages/metadata-protocol` at `43c50c843`. It took `permissionSetDefinitionFromRow` over a 17.x-shaped row (`admin_scope` carrying both keys as `false`) and passed the body to `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.saveMetaItem`. That is the door `os migrate organization-ownership` composes (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts:567-578`).
  - The door answered `{"ok":false,"code":"INVALID_METADATA","status":422}` at `adminScope.manageBindings`, with the tombstone's prescription.
  - CONTROL: the same row without the two keys saved, `{"ok":true,"success":true}`.
  - So the save does not replay the conversion. That matches `conversions/stored.ts`'s header: "The write path must NOT use this: `saveMetaItem` rejects off-spec bodies with the current schema".
- Fix: `permission-set-row-definition.ts` drops both keys from the parsed `admin_scope` (`RETIRED_ADMIN_SCOPE_KEYS`).
- New pin: the body without the keys passes `PermissionSetSchema` for `false`, `true` and a non-boolean value. A CONTROL shows the same body with the key kept is refused at `['adminScope','manageBindings']`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts` is read only, not edited (mechanism assumption 4 holds).

**4. Position 3 text (docs accuracy, no contract change).**
- `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`: the action-flag and strict-containment rows.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`: the strict-containment sentence.
- The showcase's seven sentences: five in `examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts` (`:26-27`, `:166-167`, `:357-362`, `:384-385`, and the two keys deleted) and two in `examples/app-showcase/src/docs/showcase_tour_security.md`.
- The spec JSDoc (`AdminScopeSchema` header, `assignablePermissionSets`, `PermissionSet.adminScope`).
- The ledger note.
- The two plugin-security comments: `delegated-admin-gate.ts` `scopesCoverUser` and the placement comment, and `objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/meta-write-capability.ts:184-185`: the security plugin's data door no longer asks the walled verdict. Measured: `git grep -n 'walledCatalogWriteVerdict(' -- packages` finds no caller under `packages/plugins`.
- `docs/design/permission-model.md` (the delegated-admin bullets and the authoring sample).
- `packages/platform-objects`' four `metadata-forms` bundles:
  - `en` was regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`;
  - the three translated `helpText` values (zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES) were edited by hand, since AGENTS.md allows translated-locale values to be hand-written;
  - the `adminScope` path has no source-hash entry, so it is legacy-trusted.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts` now asserts both keys are absent from the served definition.

**5. Tree-scoped absence pin.** `packages/spec/src/security/admin-scope-binding-authoring-retirement.test.ts` (registered in `vitest.repo-tests.json`) pins:
- the refusal at every door: schema, the `permission` write-door binding, and `defineStack` with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422;
- the tsc channel (`@ts-expect-error`);
- the D2 strip: stored-row rehydration, the artifact before and after, idempotence, and that it is retired from the load path;
- the registration;
- an absence walk over the five roots already declared for `@objectstack/spec` in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`.

## File surface vs the claim

These are outside the claim's list, each with the reason:
- `docs/design/permission-model.md`: the reading (Reading 5) lists it, and it named both keys as authorable.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/docs/showcase_tour_security.md`: two of "the showcase's seven" (ruling item 5).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts`: it asserted `manageBindings === false`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/*.test.ts` fixtures.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: its guard requires a JOIN row for every newest-stable retirement.
- `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json`.
- The generated `authorable-*` and reference files.

Mechanism assumption 3 does not hold: no generator wrote under `skills/**`, so this PR touches no governed surface.

## Verification

**Pre-merge head `0221b165f`.** Each command ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, with the exit code captured before any pipe:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 677 files passed, 1 skipped; 20729 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 62 files, 1051 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. That includes `check:test-typecheck`, so the two `@ts-expect-error` lines are compiled and used.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0.
- plugin-security, 7 targeted files (`delegated-admin-gate*.test.ts`, `granted-by-writer-provenance`, `reserved-identity-names`, `can-write-object-admission`): 206 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/**`), regenerated with `gen:docs`. Every other gate was green.

**Reverse verification, at `0221b165f`, both restored and proved by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`:**
- **Gate.** `delegated-admin-gate.ts` at the branch point `fa6a6085c` was written over the file. Of the four selected cases, 2 failed (case (ii) and case (i) reversed) and 2 passed (the CONTROL and the existing equal-scope refusal). That is the expected direction.
- **Mapper.** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` removed the `withoutRetiredAdminScopeKeys(...)` call (anchor 1 → 0, blob `03f32ba6f610` → `01d09ba3e389`). The mapper pin failed (1 failed, 12 passed), and the file was restored to the HEAD blob.

**objectui at the pin (`b9814b334d`), measured by reproduction, not by a full objectui build.**
- I typechecked a copy of `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx`'s typing against this branch's built `@objectstack/spec` dist. The copy covered the `AdminScope` import, `Partial` alias, `setScopeDetail`, the three switches' `scope[key]` and the `{ [key]: !!v } as Partial` write, plus `DelegableAdminScope`. It used objectui's compiler options (`strict`, `moduleResolution: bundler`) and TypeScript 6.0.3, and exited 0.
- CONTROL: a literal `{ businessUnit: 'x', manageBindings: false }` typed as `AdminScope` fails `TS2322` (the retired mark), and `DelegableAdminScope['manageBindings']` fails `TS2339`. So the reproduction reads the new types.
- A full objectui build at the pin is NOT MEASURED.

**Merged head `3854d1403`** (`origin/main` merged through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`): the closure rebuild, the derived gate families, the consumer typechecks and the dogfood zoo file were in progress when this PR opened. Their readings go into the `os-dev-report` comment on #23488, and CI's check-runs on this PR are authoritative.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not edited:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts:333-336`. It describes the retired `sys_permission_set.admin_scope` column as it was, both keys included. That is accurate for a model of a retired object; carrier: none.
- **Left as they are (PROSPECTIVE, not false):** three sentences describe a door that ADR-0138 D3 item 4 assigns to the bind door when it is built: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/builtin-positions.ts:92`, `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:1099-1100`, and `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` "the wildcard ban is the stricter `guest` tier's rule". Carrier: none.
- **Release-owned, not touched:** `content/docs/releases/v13.mdx:91` and the `CHANGELOG.md` entries.
- **Out-of-repo stored rows and consumers:** NOT MEASURED, as the reading stated.
